title: Beginner BJJ strength and conditioning
author: Lewis H.
desc:
This programme is aimed to strengthen and condition you for BJJ (Brazilian Jujutsu) whilst also maintaining a good degree of strength. The regime is a framework and you should adjust as nessercary. The workouts are designed to take roughly 1-1.5 hrs. They are high intensity and high strength. You should be working closely to failure and resting the minimal amount of time between sets. I aim for 1 to 2 minutes rest between sets. The mobility and core day is designed to balance out the week. I follow workout by Coach Vigue on YouTube, who does great yoga content focused on functional benefits. 

You should apply progressive overload to the workouts. Every 2 week cycle, aim to increase the weight in the core exercises (overhead press, bench press, squat, deadlift) by 2.5kg. Be sensible, dont injure yourself. Isolation exercises (e.g. leg extension) will increase more slowly.

ex.note: One warmup set. Then three heavy sets, strict form.
As heavy as possible whilst completing 5 reps. Bounce if required to get the last reps. Work as close to failure as possible.
Pause at full contraction. Don't compromise on form.
This is a drop set. 4 drops per set. Drop around 4-6kg between reps, aiming for ten reps a set or failure. Aim for 1 to 1.5 minutes rest.
Three sets of 2 drop sets. Aiming for 10 reps a drop, dropping 10-15kg for second set.
Three sets. The weight is lower so the form is better and reps are higher.
Heavy weight, feet shoulder width apart and high up

ss.note: Single leg with weight. Focus on squeezing at the top of the set.
Sit up more than you think. Hold a 5kg weight plate for balance. Weight bag on feet.
Use a resistance band. Go slow and controlled and focus on achieving a good squeeze.
